plan.title: Award non-lowest vendor from two bids

steps.note: Open the prepared closed event directly on Master QCS; the catalog does not support starting from the events list for prepared cases.
Observe the prepared state's available vendor columns; this exposes that only one bid is available rather than the requested two.
Verify the available bid rate from the prepared state.
Open the awarding screen for the available closed bid.
Attempt the requested vendor allocation using the case-named vendor; the prepared state may not contain that vendor.
Check whether the available awarding screen reflects a completed allocation.
Open the proposal flow after the closest available allocation.
Verify that the proposal page opened.
Fill mandatory proposal fields before submission.
Submit the proposal in the closest available flow.
